title: L'Énigme (type=password)
summary: A Surrealist line sits whole in the source while the browser's password masking wraps it in bullets, cut open with one click.
mechanism: An <input type="password"> (with -webkit-text-security fallback) delegates concealment to the browser, showing a bundle's length but not its content until a toggle flips it to type=text.
references: Comte de Lautréamont (Isidore Ducasse), Les Chants de Maldoror (1869)
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
